prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic cinematic full-body portrait in Paris on a moody overcast day. Use the attached approved-adult face reference and preserve the person's face, facial structure, expression, and likeness exactly, with no celebrity or public-figure substitution. They lean casually against a massive gray riveted steel industrial column at frame right, hands in pockets with one leg crossed over the other. Dress them in a long structured black wool overcoat, fitted black turtleneck, belted black trousers, and sturdy black leather boots. In the misty bokeh background place the Eiffel Tower, a horizontal metal railing, and blurred autumn trees. Use wet slick asphalt with subtle reflections, soft diffuse rainy-afternoon light, realistic column weathering, an 85mm lens at f/2, shallow depth, and desaturated cinematic gray-brown-black tones.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, identity blending, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed
